an9.1:0.1: 9. navakanipāto 1. paṭhamo paṇṇāsako namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammā sambuddhassa
an9.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme,
an9.1:1.3: tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhu āmantesi. bhikkhavoti. bhadanteti te bhikkhu bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca:
an9.1:2.1: sace bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ:
an9.1:2.2: sambodhipakkhiyānaṃ āvuso dhammānaṃ kā upanisā bhāvanāyāti. evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ kinti byākareyyāthāti.
an9.1:2.3: bhagavammūlakā no bhante dhammā bhagavannettikā, bhagavampaṭisaraṇā, sādhu vata bhante bhagavantaññeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho. bhagavato sutvā bhikkhu dhāressantīti.
an9.1:3.1: tena hi bhikkhave suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmīti.
an9.1:3.2: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhu bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an9.1:4.1: sace bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ
an9.1:4.2: sambodhipakkhiyānaṃ āvuso dhammānaṃ kā upanisā bhāvanāyāti. evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyātha:
an9.1:5.1: idhāvuso bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto hoti kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko.
an9.1:5.2: sambodhipakkhiyānaṃ āvuso dhammānaṃ ayaṃ paṭhamā upanisā bhāvanāya.
an9.1:6.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an9.1:6.2: sambodhipakkhiyānaṃ āvuso dhammānaṃ ayaṃ dutiyā upanisā bhāvanāya.
an9.1:7.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu yāyaṃ kathā abhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā seyyathīdaṃ: appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavivekakathā asaṃsaggakathā viriyārambhakathā sīlakathā samādhikathā paññākathā vimuttikathā vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā. evarūpiyā kathāya nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an9.1:7.2: sambodhipakkhiyānaṃ āvuso dhammānaṃ ayaṃ tatiyā upanisā bhāvanāya.
an9.1:8.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
an9.1:8.2: sambodhipakkhiyānaṃ āvuso dhammānaṃ ayaṃ catutthi upanisā bhāvanāya.
an9.1:9.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā. sambodhipakkhiyānaṃ
an9.1:9.2: āvuso dhammānaṃ ayaṃ pañcamī upanisā bhāvanāya.
an9.1:10.1: kalyāṇamittassetaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa
an9.1:10.2: sīlavā bhavissati pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharissati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an9.1:11.1: kalyāṇamittassetaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa
an9.1:11.2: yāyaṃ kathā abhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā seyyathīdaṃ: appicchakathā …pe… evarūpiyā kathāya nikāmalābhī bhavissati akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an9.1:12.1: kalyāṇamittassetaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa:
an9.1:12.2: āraddhaviriyo viharissati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
an9.1:13.1: kalyāṇamittassetaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa:
an9.1:13.2: paññavā bhavissati udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
an9.1:14.1: tena ca pana bhikkhave bhikkhunā imesu pañcasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya cattāro dhammā uttariṃ bhāvetabbā:
an9.1:14.2: asubhā bhāvetabbā rāgassa pahānāya. mettā bhāvetabbā vyāpādassa pahānāya. ānāpānasati bhāvetabbā vitakkupacchedāya. aniccasaññā bhāvetabbā asmimānasamugghātāya,
an9.1:14.4: anattasaññī asmimānasamugghātaṃ pāpuṇāti, diṭṭheva dhamme nibbānanti.
